title: Synonym: The Ultimate Guide
description: Comprehensive guide to SQL Server synonyms including creation, listing, and best practices.

data.text: SQL Server Synonym: The Ultimate Guide
A synonym provides an alias for a database object, offering benefits like simplified object names, seamless object renaming, and backward compatibility for existing applications.

items: Provide a layer of abstraction over base objects.
Allow backward compatibility when renaming database objects such as tables, views, stored procedures, and functions.
Enable seamless object name changes without modifying existing applications.

data.text: You can list all synonyms in the current database using the sys.synonyms catalog view:

data.title: List All Synonyms
data.content: Queries all synonyms with their base object names.
data.code:
SELECT 
    name, 
    base_object_name, 
    type
FROM 
    sys.synonyms
ORDER BY 
    name;

data.alt: SQL Server Synonym example output showing synonyms list

items: When referencing objects from another database or remote server, create a synonym in your database for simpler access.
When renaming a table or other object, create a synonym with the old name to maintain backward compatibility with existing applications.
When you want to provide a simplified, shorter name for a complex object reference.

data.title: Synonym Ultimate Guide Key Points
points: Synonyms provide abstraction and simplify object references.
Use synonyms for cross-database or cross-server object references.
Synonyms enable seamless renaming of underlying objects.
List synonyms using sys.synonyms catalog view.
Drop synonyms with DROP SYNONYM when no longer needed.
